data.name: Clara
data.gender_notes: Clara is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin clarus, 'bright, clear, famous'. Its root is Latin clarus. Saint Clare of Assisi (Chiara). Clara is a Latin name meaning “Bright; clear; famous”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Clara expresses “Bright; clear; famous”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Latin clarus, 'bright, clear, famous'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Clara total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
